field_changes.old:
This release brings a smoother Search & Filter experience and a more stable app:
Search and filters now stay anchored at the top of the screen while your results scroll underneath.
After updating your equipment from Search & Filter, you're taken straight back to your filter.
Fixed workout logging where values could carry over between exercises in landscape mode.
Fixed several crashes.
Need a hand or have feedback? Reach our team anytime at hello@centr.com.
field_changes.new:
We've made your big-screen workouts better this release: when you cast or mirror, you'll see your progress and current exercise, and the progress bar keeps pace as you go. We also cleared up a few issues so your music and your login behave the way they should.

Questions, feedback, or need help? We're here: hello@centr.com.
